answer: The September 15 meeting included the Mayor's appearance, a consent agenda with 15 items, Street Tree Standards, and later budget and policy business. This agenda-level rehearsal view will be replaced by grounded Gemini summaries when the live API is available.

bullets.text: The Mayor's appearance began at 2:32 into the meeting.

evidence.item_title: 3 SPECIAL ORDER 2:00 P.M. - Mayor’s Appearance Before The Board[Mayor Appearance Boiler 01-2013|B1,B2]
evidence.summary: Mayor Daniel Lurie addressed the Board during the special order regarding San Francisco's rental emergency and housing affordability. He highlighted proposed caps on banked rent increases, enhanced tenant eviction protections, and expanded right-to-counsel funding, while announcing early labor contract agreements reached with over a dozen city employee unions. The matter was discussed and filed.

quotes.name: Mayor
quotes.text: SAN FRANCISCO IS IN A RENT EMERGENCY. AND I WANT TO SAY HOW GRATEFUL I AM FOR YOUR PARTNERSHIP IN COMING TOGETHER TO MEET THIS MOMENT.

bullets.text: The consent agenda grouped items 1 through 15, including listed lawsuit settlements and unlitigated claims.

evidence.summary: The Board considered routine consent agenda items 1 through 15 together. The ordinances passed on first reading and the resolutions were adopted by a unanimous vote.

bullets.text: Street Tree Standards, appeals, and the Adopt-A-Tree Fund followed the consent agenda.
bullets.item_title: Street Tree Standards, Appeals, and Adopt-A-Tree Fund

evidence.item_title: Public Works, Administrative, Planning, Business and Tax Regulations Codes - Street Tree Standards, Appeals, and Adopt-A-Tree Fund
evidence.summary: The Board took up an ordinance amending the Public Works, Administrative, Planning, and Business and Tax Regulations Codes to allow in-lieu fees for street tree planting, exempt accessory dwelling units from planting rules, and adjust appeal procedures for hazardous tree removals. The ordinance was finally passed on a 7-4 vote.
